# HSRPv1 (`hsrp`)

- **Layer**: Application and control
- **Header**: 20 octets (fixed)
- **Notes**: [Redundancy protocols (FHRP)](../../protocols/fhrp.md)

## Reached from

| Lower layer | Selector | Value |
|---|---|---|
| [`udp`](udp.md) | `dst_port` / `src_port` | 1985 (0x07c1) |

## Fields

| Field | Type | Default | Auto | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `version` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   | HSRP version (0 for HSRPv1). |
| `op_code` | `enum(8)` | `0` (hello) |   | HSRP operation (0 = Hello, 1 = Coup, 2 = Resign, 3 = Advertise). |
| `state` | `enum(8)` | `16` (active) |   | Sender state (1 = Learn, 2 = Listen, 4 = Speak, 8 = Standby, 16 = Active). |
| `hello_time` | `uint(8)` | `3` |   | Interval between Hello messages, in seconds. |
| `hold_time` | `uint(8)` | `10` |   | Time a Hello stays valid, in seconds. |
| `priority` | `uint(8)` | `100` |   | Router priority within the group. |
| `group` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   | Standby group number. |
| `reserved` | `uint(8)` | `0` |   |   |
| `auth_data` | `bytes(8)` | `63 69 73 63 6f 00 00 00` |   | Clear-text authentication password (8 octets, default "cisco"). |
| `virtual_ip` | `ipv4` | `192.0.2.254` |   | Virtual IPv4 address of the group. |

### `op_code`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 (0x00) | `hello` |
| 1 (0x01) | `coup` |
| 2 (0x02) | `resign` |
| 3 (0x03) | `advertise` |

### `state`

| Value | Name |
|---|---|
| 0 (0x00) | `initial` |
| 1 (0x01) | `learn` |
| 2 (0x02) | `listen` |
| 4 (0x04) | `speak` |
| 8 (0x08) | `standby` |
| 16 (0x10) | `active` |
